transcript: I have an unhinged love of princess diana the musical, tv Shows, movies, documentaries. If it's about Diana Spencer, I am in. So yes. Diana the untold and Untrue Story might be the most perfectly tailored for me show to ever exist. It's part of Soho Playhouse's Fringe Encore series, which takes fringe shows from all around the world and brings them to New York. And this is Princess Diana's solo show where she finally gets to tell her story. Not the polite version, not the royal version, her version. And it's pure chaos, it’s campy and ridiculous with niche theatre references. It involves audience participation and puppets. And some very exciting to me virtual guest stars It is I Lady Di! Diana the Untold Untrue Story was created by Awkward Productions, who I love. I've seen two of their other fringe shows, Gwyneth go skiing and the fit prince and they're all wildly silly and a little bit awkward and deeply delightful. Linus Carp and Joseph Martin have infectious, chaotic joy and they know how to bring the audience along with them so everyone feels like they’re in on the joke It also, spoiler alert gives Diana the happy ending she deserves. You only have a few days to catch Diana in New York, but it's only 75 minutes, so you definitely should find time to squeeze it in. This was my first show of 2026, and honestly, what a great sign for the theatre year ahead!
